chunks.title: FIR Summary & Narrative
chunks.text: FIR No. 412/2025 registered at Cyber Crime PS Lucknow on 15-Oct-2025 under Section 318(4) BNS, 319 BNS and Section 66D IT Act on written application of Alok Ranjan Tripathi. Complainant alleges he was added to a Telegram group 'Global Review Taskers' by user '@Kavya_HR' promising ₹300 per Google review. After completing 3 tasks and receiving ₹900, he was lured into VIP Crypto Investment scheme promising 40% daily return. He deposited total ₹18,50,000 across multiple bank accounts between 14-Oct and 15-Oct.

chunks.title: वादी का हस्तलिखित शिकायती पत्र
chunks.text: सेवा में श्रीमान प्रभारी निरीक्षक महोदय, साइबर क्राइम थाना, लखनऊ। निवेदन है कि प्रार्थी आलोक रंजन त्रिपाठी को दिनांक 12-10-2025 को व्हाट्सएप और टेलीग्राम पर पार्ट टाइम घर बैठे ऑनलाइन टास्क पूरा कर 3000 से 5000 रुपये प्रतिदिन कमाने का झांसा दिया गया। पहले 900 रुपये मेरे खाते में भेजे गए। बाद में वीआईपी टास्क के नाम पर मुझसे विभिन्न खातों में कुल 18 लाख 50 हजार रुपये जमा करवा लिए गए। जब मैंने अपनी जमा रकम वापस मांगी तो मुझसे 5 लाख रुपये टैक्स के नाम पर और मांगे गए। प्रार्थी के साथ धोखाधड़ी हुई है। संदिग्ध मोबाइल नंबर 918822334455 व 917711223344 हैं।

chunks.text: Complainant HDFC A/c 50100492817291: Txn 1: 14-Oct-2025 16:42 IST UTR HDFC987123 Rs 5,00,000 to Yes Bank A/c 019283746501 (Beneficiary: Rameshwar Yadav Enterprises). Txn 2: 15-Oct-2025 10:15 IST UTR HDFC987441 Rs 5,00,000 to Yes Bank A/c 019283746501. chunks.title: CFCFRMS Layer 1 & Layer 2 Money Trail Memo
chunks.text: 1930 Portal Acknowledgement No. UP-2025-88291: Yes Bank A/c 019283746501 (Layer 1 Mule) received ₹10,00,000 on 14/15-Oct. Within 18 minutes, ₹6,00,000 was layered to Canara Bank A/c 294810293847 (Layer 2 Mule - Holder: Sunil Kumar, Bareilly), ₹2,50,000 layered to Kotak Mahindra Bank A/c 8839201928 (Layer 2 - Holder: Dinesh Maurya, Sitapur), and ₹1,50,000 withdrawn via ATM in Moradabad. Freeze order placed under Sec 107 BNSS: Canara Bank account currently holds ₹4,20,000 debit frozen.

chunks.title: Accused Rameshwar Yadav Arrest Memo (Sec 187 BNSS Custody)
chunks.text: Arrest memo of Rameshwar Yadav s/o Ram Lal, arrested on 05-Nov-2025 from Lucknow Charbagh Railway station. Recovered: 1 Vivo smartphone containing 14 activated mule SIM cards, 8 debit cards, and Cheque book of Yes Bank A/c 019283746501. Accused admitted providing bank accounts on 2% commission to a syndicate coordinator operating on Telegram handle '@BossTrader99'. Remand obtained on 06-Nov-2025. 60-day default bail clock under Section 187 BNSS expires on 04-Jan-2026.

gaps.action_required: Obtain signed Section 63 BSA certificate from Complainant for Telegram chat printouts and mobile device.
Issue follow-up notice under Section 94 BNSS to Canara Bank Bareilly Branch Manager for Sunil Kumar KYC.
Analysis shows suspect phone active at Charbagh at time of cash withdrawal.
Mandatory progress update due to complainant by 13-Jan-2026.

chunks.title: FIR Summary & Digital Arrest Allegation
chunks.text: Complainant Dr. Sudha Srivastava, retired professor, received an IVR call claiming her mobile number was linked to 17 illegal money-laundering bank accounts in Mumbai. The call was transferred via Skype video call displaying a fake police station backdrop with an impersonator in IPS officer uniform. Impersonator threatened non-bailable arrest warrant from Hon'ble Supreme Court and forced complainant to stay in 'Digital Arrest' in her room for 36 hours. Under extreme coercion, she transferred funds to 'RBI Verification Accounts'.

planted_contradiction.field_1: Complainant stated electricity payment link asked to pay ₹10 via 'UPPCL Quick Pay'
planted_contradiction.field_2: APK decompilation shows malware forwards SMS to phone +91-7001928374 registered under Jamtara circle
planted_contradiction.description: Mismatch in accused representation vs actual malware recipient infrastructure.

chunks.title: Electricity Bill Malware Summary
chunks.text: Victim received SMS: 'Dear consumer your electricity power will be disconnected tonight at 9.30 PM from UPPCL office because your previous month bill was not updated. Please immediately contact electricity officer at 9811223344'. When called, victim was told to install 'UPPCL_Bill_Update.apk' to pay ₹10 nominal charge. The APK requested Accessibility & SMS reading permissions, intercepted Netbanking OTP and transferred ₹3,80,000 to Airtel Payments Bank.

gaps.action_required: Calculate SHA-256 hash of malicious APK and submit to Forensic Science Laboratory (FSL) Lucknow.

chunks.title: OLX Furniture Sale Scam Details
chunks.text: Complainant posted wooden sofa set for sale on OLX for ₹25,000. Accused messaged pretending to be Army Subedar transferred to Noida cantonment. Accused claimed Army Accounts Department only pays via merchant QR code. Accused sent QR code asking victim to scan to 'receive' ₹25,000. On scanning, ₹25,000 was debited. Accused apologised claiming technical error, sent another QR of ₹50,000 to reverse, tricking victim into losing ₹2,40,000 total. Suspect phone number matches +91-9188223344 (active in Lucknow FIR 412/2025).

gaps.action_required: Requisition merchant registration and bank settlement logs from PhonePe nodal officer.

chunks.title: Corporate Deepfake Wire Fraud Narrative
chunks.text: CFO Naveen Aggarwal received a WhatsApp call from an unknown UK number with the profile picture and exact clone voice of Managing Director Mr. R.K. Singhal. The caller claimed an emergency acquisition of industrial tooling was closing in 2 hours and instructed immediate RTGS of ₹32,00,000 to an authorized vendor escrow account in Federal Bank. The transfer was made before discovering the MD was boarding a flight.

gaps.action_required: Submit WhatsApp call audio recording to CDAC / CFSL for deepfake voice synthesis verification.
